classification.difficultyReason: Identify equal angles standing on the same arc, then use the angle sum of a triangle.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Unshaded cyclic quadrilateral with both diagonals. The full upper-left interior angle has an arc labelled 80 degrees. The lower-right angle between its diagonal and right side is 55 degrees. The upper-right angle between the top side and diagonal is x. Vertex names are internal construction coordinates and are not printed.
spec.mathematics: With internal vertices A, B, C, D in clockwise source order, angle DAB is 80 degrees, angle ACB is 55 degrees, and x is angle ABD. All four vertices lie on the circle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only x and the supplied 80-degree and 55-degree givens appear; the supplied answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
The angle at the lower-left vertex between the left side and diagonal is $55^\circ$, since angles at the circumference standing on the same arc are equal.
$$\begin{aligned}x+80^\circ+55^\circ&=180^\circ\\x&=45^\circ\end{aligned}$$
